title: Satellites and invariants of links
summary: An invariant $v$ of $m$-component links is called "cableable" if there exists a $k$ such that whenever a link $L'$ is obtained from a link $L=(K_1,\dots,K_m)$ by replacing each knot $K_i$ with its $(p_i,q_i)$-cable for some $p_i$ and $q_i$, we have $v(L')=(p_1\cdots p_m)^kv(L)$. The following problem is implicit in a number of papers by P. M.
